name: Quarren
description: The Quarren, also known by the derogatory nickname "Squid Heads," were a humanoid, squid-like sentient species native to the planet Mon Cala, where they coexisted with the Mon Calamari in a peaceful, albeit tense, relationship.

data.name: Quarren
data.distinctions: Four tentacles protruding from jaw; finned or suction-cup tipped fingers; ability to spit ink in defense
